title: Causal-rule inventory with SME sign-off
description: Machine-readable inventory of every causal rule in a domain's kernels, each carrying provenance classification and a per-rule SME review record. The gate is SIGNED_OFF only when every rule verdict is non-PENDING and the reviewer field names a human.

domainVersion.description: Must match the DomainPlugin version this inventory describes.

status.description: SIGNED_OFF requires smeGate.verdict == SIGNED_OFF and every rule reviewed.

reviewer.description: Human reviewer name. null while pending.

notModeled.description: Explicit list of real-world behaviours deliberately absent from the model. Reviewers confirm this list matches reality.

kernel.description: file:symbol location of the implementing code.

claim.description: What the kernel asserts about cause and effect. Must be checkable against real-world behaviour.

realWorldBasis.description: How this maps to reality, including known deviations. Honest deviations belong here, not in footnotes.

provenance.description: grounded = textbook/derivable. deliberate-simplification = directionally right, magnitudes/boundaries simplified. pedagogical-fiction = contrived constant/coupling that must never be quoted as physical. unknown/disputed = no settled basis; blocks sign-off.

confidence.description: Free-form but expected vocabulary: high | medium | medium-high | high-direction-low-magnitude | high-direction-low-boundaries | direction-only | methodology-disclosed.

affectsChannels.description: Observation channels whose readings depend on this rule.

diagnosticHeuristicTrained.description: The heuristic a learner walks away with after repeated exposure. Required when provenance is deliberate-simplification or pedagogical-fiction.

reviewerNote.description: Required (non-null) for REWORD/RETUNE/REMOVE: what to change and why.
